verdicts.reason: Both lose the dark brand header (the SOLSTICE logo shrinks to an illegible speck at top-left), and both keep the paragraph body copy and the long legal block at unreadable sizes, so the legal text weighs as much as the message in a cramped strip. A drops the 'Limited Summer Release' eyebrow but keeps a cleaner left/centre/right order: copy, then headline over CTA, then legal. B moves the eyebrow to the bottom-right under the legal text, which breaks the reading order and muddles hierarchy. B's body copy is also squeezed into ragged, awkward wrapping.
